newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc profits from dlr weakness, ends higher.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc profits from dlr weakness, ends higher.

text.p: 1550 GMT - The Swiss franc closed higher on the dollar and mark in a continued correction against the two currencies and it now seemed poised for a test of key resistance levels.

The move through 1.2630/40 franc resistance against the dollar could lead to an eventual test of 1.2500. But a move past this level toward 1.2450 would mean that a major reversal was under way, one technical analyst said.
The mark was holding support at 84.00, but may be faced with a test of 83.55 support within the next few days, he added.
Separately, the Swiss National Bank (SNB) reported that sight deposits remained relatively high during the first 10 days of November, showing a gain of 246.7 millikon francs to 3.48 billion.

An SNB spokesman said the central bank's response to a greater demand for liquidity demand showed that the central bank was still flexible in the money market. * Dollar closes at 1.2579/2584 francs vs 1.2721/2727 * Mark ends at 84.02/05 centimes vs 84.32/35 * Three-month eurofrancs 1.82/92 pct -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
